headline: Seven Sectors See Sharp Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition the front has widened. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theatre, its 24‑hour toll now 174,891 Colonial and 192,663 Warden dead with twenty‑two ownership changes; casualty streams and enlistments are still accelerating. Fishermans Row has surged to sixteen flips, Black Well and Dankana Post the busiest posts, and casualties climbing to 11,556 Colonial and 13,891 Warden. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to twelve flips centred on Buckler Sound, Colonial losses at 57,840 and Warden at 73,332, both casualty rates and sign‑ups climbing sharply. Farranac Coast continues to churn with ten flips, control split one Warden to nine Colonial bases, and casualties at 47,049 Colonial and 58,146 Warden. Linn Mercy logs eleven flips around Lathair and Rotdust, totals 54,626 Colonial and 68,969 Warden casualties, recruitment rising. Gutter, quiet in the prior edition, has erupted with ten flips centred on The Parras. Stlican Shelf adds five flips, casualties 56,420 Colonial and 62,877 Warden. Meanwhile Deadlands, the northern Warden‑held sectors and several rear areas show no ownership changes in the last twelve hours.
